landing.title: One person, four points of view.
landing.lead: Collect feedback from a manager, peers, direct reports and the person themselves, then compare how each group sees the same skills.

steps.title: Set up
steps.body: Invite your team, set who reports to whom, and pick a question template.

steps.title: Nominate
steps.body: Everyone nominates peers to review them. Managers approve the list.

steps.title: Review
steps.body: Reviewers rate each skill from 1 to 5 and leave optional comments.

steps.title: Release
steps.body: Reports show scores by group. Peer and report groups stay anonymous.

landing.anonymity: Peer and direct-report scores only appear once at least three people in that group have responded.

preview.label: Sample report
preview.gapBody: Rated higher by self than by peers

landing.viewsLead: A single score hides that. 360 Scoring keeps each group separate so the gaps show.
landing.featuresTitle: Built for a real review cycle

features.title: Anonymity with a threshold
features.body: Peer and report scores stay hidden until at least three people respond.

features.title: Reusable templates
features.body: Group statements into skills once and reuse them every cycle.

features.title: Invite by email or CSV
features.body: Bring a whole team in at once, including who reports to whom.

features.title: Clear stages
features.body: Draft, nomination, review, closed, released. Everyone knows what is next.

features.title: In-app reminders
features.body: Pending nominations and reviews land in each person’s task list.

features.title: Two languages
features.body: Switch between Indonesian and English at any time.

landing.ctaBody: Set it up in minutes, or look around the demo first.

onboarding.title: Create your organization
onboarding.body: This is where your team, review templates and cycles live. You'll be its admin.

app.welcomeBody: You're in {{org}}. Here's what comes next.

members.title: Add your team
members.body: Invite people by email or import a CSV, and set each person's manager.

template.title: Prepare questions
template.body: Start from the default template or write your own skills and statements.

cycle.title: Start a cycle
cycle.body: Choose who's reviewed, set deadlines, and open nominations.

invites.bannerBody: {{org}} invited you to join their team.
invites.pageBody: Choose a password so you can sign in again later.
invites.noSession: This invitation link has expired or was already used. Sign in with the invited email, or ask your admin to resend it.

members.title: Members
members.deactivateHint: Deactivated people can't sign in to this organization. Their past reviews are kept.

result.existing_account: They already have an account, so they'll see the invitation when they sign in.
result.send_failed: The invite email couldn't be sent ({{reason}}). They can still join by signing up with {{email}}.

errors.manager_loop: That manager reports to this person, which would create a loop.
errors.last_admin: This organization needs at least one active admin.
errors.not_allowed: You don't have permission to change this member.

import.title: Import members from CSV
import.body: Upload a CSV with the columns name, email, job_title and manager_email. Managers can be people already in the organization or other rows in the same file.
import.missingColumns: The file needs at least the columns name and email. Found: {{found}}.

issues.duplicate_in_file: Same email appears earlier in the file
issues.exists: Already a member — will be skipped
issues.manager_not_found: Manager email isn't in the organization or this file
issues.manager_self: Someone can't be their own manager

import.doneEmailFailedHint: Supabase's built-in email service only sends a few emails per hour. Those people can still join by signing up with their invited email.

templates.title: Templates
templates.body: A template is the list of skills and statements people are rated on. Cycles copy their template when they start, so later edits don't change a running cycle.
templates.empty: No templates yet. Start from the default template or a blank one.
templates.name: Template name
templates.confirmDelete: Delete this template? Cycles that already started keep their own copy.
templates.savedHint: Changes save when you leave a field.
templates.scale: Each statement is rated 1–5, or “Not able to rate”.

cycles.title: Cycles
cycles.body: A cycle is one round of 360° reviews, from nominating peers to releasing reports.
cycles.emptyMember: There are no active cycles yet.
cycles.name: Cycle name
cycles.settingsLocked: The template and peer limits are fixed once the cycle starts.
cycles.participantsHelp: People who will be reviewed. Their manager and direct reports are added as reviewers automatically.
cycles.onlyActive: Only active members can take part. Invited people appear once they join.

draft.title: Open nominations
draft.body: The template is copied, managers and direct reports become reviewers, and each participant can nominate peers.

nomination.title: Start reviews
nomination.body: Approved peers become reviewers and everyone can start filling in reviews. Nominations still waiting are dropped.

review.title: Close reviews
review.body: No more reviews can be submitted. Admins and managers can see reports.

closed.title: Release reports
closed.body: Each participant can see their own report.

cycles.pendingWarning_one: {{count}} nomination is still waiting for approval.
cycles.pendingWarning_other: {{count}} nominations are still waiting for approval.
cycles.reviewsSoon: Review forms arrive in the next update.

noms.mineHelp: Choose {{min}}–{{max}} colleagues who know your work. Your manager approves the list. Your manager and direct reports already review you.
noms.mineHelpNoManager: Choose {{min}}–{{max}} colleagues who know your work. An admin approves the list.
noms.approveHelp: Check that each person picked colleagues who can fairly judge their work.

reviews.title: Your reviews
reviews.body: Reviews you've been asked to give. Your answers save as you go, and you can finish later.
reviews.empty: No reviews for you right now.

note.self: This is your own view. In your report it's shown next to how others see you.
note.manager: Your answers appear as the manager's view in their report.
note.anonymous: Your answers are combined with others in the same group and only appear once at least {{min}} people have answered. Your name is never shown.

reviews.commentPlaceholder: Optional: an example, a strength, or a suggestion
reviews.confirmSubmit: Submit this review? You can't change it afterwards.
reviews.readOnly: This review was submitted and can't be changed.
reviews.readOnlyClosed: Reviews for this cycle are closed.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.nomination_open: Nominations are open for {{cycle}}. Choose your peer reviewers.

report.title: 360° report
report.othersHelp: Others combines the manager and every anonymous group with at least {{min}} responses.
report.othersHidden: Not enough responses from others to show a combined score.
report.selfVsOthers: How you see yourself vs. how others see you
report.selfVsOthersOther: Self-view vs. how others see them
report.gapsHelp: Skills where the self-view and others' view are at least 0.5 apart.
report.blindSpotHelp: Others see this less strongly — worth asking for examples.
report.hiddenStrengthHelp: Others see more strength here than the self-view does.
report.noGaps: Self-view and others' view are close on every skill.
report.needOthers: Shown once others' scores are available.
report.needSelf: Shown once a self-review is submitted.
report.scaleNote: Scores are averages on a 1–5 scale. “Not able to rate” answers are left out.
report.reportsHelpAdmin: Admins and each person's manager can see reports once reviews are closed. People see their own after release.

demo.title: Try it without signing up
demo.body: Open a ready-made organization with real-looking data. Pick whose eyes to see it through.

admin.label: Admin
admin.what: Runs cycles, manages people and sees every report.

manager.label: Manager
manager.what: Approves peer nominations and reviews their team.

employee.label: Employee
employee.what: Nominates peers, fills in reviews and reads their own report.

demo.banner: You're exploring the demo as {{who}}. Anything you change resets every day at 03:00 WIB (20:00 UTC).
demo.noInvites: Inviting and importing people is turned off in the demo.

welcome.title: Welcome to 360 Scoring
welcome.body: See how your manager, peers, direct reports and you yourself rate the same skills — side by side.

setup.title: Set up your organization
setup.body: As an admin you add people (one by one or from a CSV), set who reports to whom, and prepare a question template.

cycle.title: Run a cycle in five stages
cycle.body: Draft → Nominations → Reviews → Closed → Released. Each stage unlocks the next step for everyone.

nominate.title: Nominate and review
nominate.body: Pick colleagues to review you, then rate the people you're asked to review from 1 to 5. Answers save as you go.

anonymous.title: Honest because it's anonymous
anonymous.body: Peer and direct-report answers only appear once at least three people in that group respond — and names are never shown.

report.title: Read your report
report.body: Once released, compare your self-view with how others see you, skill by skill, and find blind spots and hidden strengths.

ranking.title: Ranking
ranking.unrankedHelp: Fewer than {{min}} responses from others, so there is no score to rank without exposing who answered.
ranking.notYet: The ranking appears once this cycle is closed.
ranking.empty: No one in this cycle has enough responses to rank yet.
ranking.how: Scores are the average rating from the manager and every anonymous group with at least {{min}} responses, on a 1–5 scale. Self-ratings are shown for comparison but never count toward the rank.
ranking.private: Only admins and managers can see rankings. Use them to start conversations, not as the only basis for decisions.
ranking.homeEmpty: Rankings appear here when a cycle closes.
